a reduction in deciduous trees in a soft water catchment is likely to lead to a reduction in lake water pH, an increase in the sedimentary contents of non-reactive and humic-bound phosphorus and to a decrease in the abundance of isoetids and characeans.

the catchment is a key factor in determining the environmental conditions and the functioning of a lake and should therefore be taken into account in management plans.
